title: Fishing Pings
body:
![Note GIF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7d78d973abd64fb32910855c0d0b887defde0f2.gif)

The plugin plays a configurable sound and particles to the player if there's anything biting to let them know that they've caught a fish. It also adds particles when you manage or fail to catch the fish. If you're using a note particle, it allows you to set the colour.

You can reload the config via /fishping reload
